title: Police confirm that "clerical error" attributed fault to other driver in Kyle Shanahan crash

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Police confirm that "clerical error" attributed fault to other driver in Kyle Shanahan crash
sources.description: The story of the week became a much bigger story than it should have been because the 49ers deliberately delayed acknowledging that the Kyle Shanahan car accident had happened for 11 days.
